component.name: Body Harvest: Recompiled
component.summary: Static recompilation of Body Harvest for PC.

description.p:
Body Harvest: Recompiled is a project that uses N64: Recompiled to statically recompile Body Harvest into a native port. This project uses RT64 as the rendering engine to provide graphical enhancements.
The original game is required to run this project.
https://github.com/mcsoderh/BodyHarvestRecomp
